解答　积分限为 $0\leq x\leq1,x^2\leq y\leq x$，化为 $D:0\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{4},0\leq r\leq\tan\theta\sec\theta$，

$$\int_0^1dx\int_{x^2}^x(x^2+y^2)^{-\frac{1}{2}}dy=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\theta\int_0^{\tan\theta\sec\theta}\frac{1}{r}rdr=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\tan\theta\sec\theta d\theta=\sqrt{2}-1.$$
